$comment: Runs the human-in-the-lead plugin hooks in cloud sessions, which do not install plugins (HITLD-792; scripts/cloud-plugin-start.mjs). Outside the cloud every hook here exits at once. core/test/cloud-plugin.test.mjs keeps it matched to plugins/human-in-the-lead/hooks/hooks.json.

hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; p="$HOME/.claude/human-in-the-lead-cloud"; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/cloud-plugin-start.mjs" --copy; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || { echo "human-in-the-lead: this cloud session has no copy of the plugin, so its hooks cannot run" >&2; exit 2; }; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$p" exec node "$p/core/harness/claude-code/hooks/guard.mjs"

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; p="$HOME/.claude/human-in-the-lead-cloud"; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/cloud-plugin-start.mjs" --copy; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || { echo "human-in-the-lead: this cloud session has no copy of the plugin, so its hooks cannot run" >&2; exit 1; }; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$p" exec node "$p/core/harness/claude-code/hooks/progress.mjs"

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; p="$HOME/.claude/human-in-the-lead-cloud"; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/cloud-plugin-start.mjs" --copy; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || { echo "human-in-the-lead: this cloud session has no copy of the plugin, so its hooks cannot run" >&2; exit 1; }; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$p" exec node "$p/core/harness/claude-code/hooks/report-check.mjs"

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; p="$HOME/.claude/human-in-the-lead-cloud"; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/cloud-plugin-start.mjs" --copy; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || { echo "human-in-the-lead: this cloud session has no copy of the plugin, so its hooks cannot run" >&2; exit 1; }; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$p" exec node "$p/core/harness/claude-code/hooks/report-check.mjs"

[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; p="$HOME/.claude/human-in-the-lead-cloud"; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/cloud-plugin-start.mjs" --copy; [ -f "$p/hooks/hooks.json" ] || { echo "human-in-the-lead: this cloud session has no copy of the plugin, so its hooks cannot run" >&2; exit 1; }; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="$p" exec node "$p/core/harness/claude-code/hooks/store-sync.mjs" push
